summary: Phase 21 (Phase F) comprehensive testing complete: Edge Scrolling, Keeper Radio Chatter, and Bloodline Ledger all working correctly. All 28 feature tests passed, backend API fully functional (19/19 tests), no regressions detected.
passed_tests: Backend API: GET / returns 200 with status ok
Backend API: GET /saves returns list
Backend API: POST /saves creates save with lineage and policies.keeperRadio
Backend API: GET /saves/{id} retrieves full state including lineage and policies
Backend API: PUT /saves/{id} updates save correctly
Backend API: DELETE /saves/{id} removes save
Edge Scroll 1: Right edge glides camera left (active=true, vx<0, cam.x decreases >50px)
Edge Scroll 2: Leaving band stops glide (active=false, cam stable)
Edge Scroll 3: HUD bar hover never triggers glide (overCanvas=false)
Edge Scroll 4: Quick pass through band doesn't move camera (arming delay <20px)
Edge Scroll 5: Glide clamps at map bound (cam.x at 200-72*32*zoom, vx=0)
Edge Scroll 6: Toggle OFF persists in localStorage and disables glide
Edge Scroll 7: Preference survives page reload
Radio 1: Assigned keeper calls in after feeding (1 radio alert, stats.radioCalls=1)
Radio 2: Radio chatter stays in alert feed, no toast
Radio 3: Alert feed shows radio row with icon and pen message, clicking locates creature
Radio 4: Rate limiting works (second feed held in quiet window)
Radio 5: Held chatter transmits after quiet window lapses (2 calls total)
Radio 6: General-duty keepers stay silent (no radio when unassigned)
Radio 7: Policy toggle in Staff screen silences keepers (policies.keeperRadio=false)
Radio 8: Radio stinger plays (stinger:radio in audio log)
Ledger 1: Registry tracks founders + offspring with parent IDs (3 entries)
Ledger 2: Offspring entry carries given name (not generic species name)
Ledger 3: Founder view shows wild origin, offspring listed, descendant count
Ledger 4: Offspring node names mate and shows IN PARK status
Ledger 5: Pairing outlook shows mate as SAFE 0%, offspring as INBRED RISK 33%
Ledger 6: Clicking living relative closes ledger and selects creature
Ledger 7: Offspring view shows both parents and wild grandparents
Ledger 8: Transferred sire stays in registry as TRANSFERRED with leftDay
Ledger 9: Tree shows departed sire (not clickable), outlook lists only park residents
Ledger 10: Registry and radio policy survive save/load
Ledger 11: Legacy save backfills founders + parent stubs from genes.parents

UI Integration: Sandbox game starts, canvas and controls load

UI Integration: Edge scrolling behavior works (camera moves on edge hover)
UI Integration: Staff screen opens with radio toggle
UI Integration: Alerts feed opens and displays correctly
UI Integration: Scenario loads with creatures
